title: Internal-external attention switching SEEG epochs, DMN and DAN channels, 25 epilepsy patients (Hammer et al. 2024)
description: Stereo-EEG epochs from 25 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a task that alternated between external attention (visual search) and internal attention (yes/no statements about personal experiences). Epochs span -4 to +4 s around each task switch. Only bipolar channels assigned to the default mode network (DMN) and dorsal attention network (DAN) are retained. The dataset is a derivative repackaging of the authors' preprocessed epochs in iEEG-BIDS format. Note: the source release does not state the physical unit; channels are labelled µV based on the amplitude range, but this is an assumption by the dataset curators, not a statement of the original authors.
methods_description: Presurgical SEEG was recorded with DIXI Medical depth electrodes and Quantum/NeuroWorks amplifiers at 2048 Hz. The authors downsampled to 512 Hz, removed channels in pathological zones, applied bipolar referencing, a 0.1 Hz high-pass filter and a 50 Hz notch filter, and cut epochs around task switches. Channels were assigned to DMN or DAN by the Yeo-7 atlas.
